summary: Feed s164_triple is degraded with 3 faults: VLAN 20 missing/stripped (49% untagged), tool port overload (12.92 Gbps bursts vs 10 Gbps port), and high encrypted share (94.1% vs 90% NDR tolerance). NDR detection coverage is reduced by loss of segmentation context, burst-induced drops, and opaque payloads.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 never observed and 49% of packets are untagged, indicating the TAP/SPAN or packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or filtering VLAN 20. Trunk not preserved end-to-end to the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses visibility into VLAN 20 segment entirely; segmentation-aware detection, asset grouping, and lateral movement detection for VLAN 20 fails. Untagged packets cannot be correlated to correct tenant/policy.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q preservation on TAP/SPAN and packet broker egress, and remove any VLAN filter dropping VLAN 20, so NDR receives both VLANs 10 and 20 with tags intact.

findings.root_cause: Microbursts peak at 12.92 Gbps in 1ms intervals, 129% of the NDR's 10 Gbps port capacity (2 overloaded intervals). Aggregate feed bursts exceed single tool port line rate.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR ingress buffers will overflow during bursts causing indiscriminate packet drops, incomplete flows and missed detections, even though packet_drops check is currently healthy. NDR needs both directions and full payload, so any drop breaks flow reassembly.

recommended_fix.why: Load-balance the feed across 2x10G NDR ports with flow-aware hashing to keep per-port utilization below 80% and absorb 12.92 Gbps bursts without loss.

findings.root_cause: 94.1% of bytes are encrypted vs NDR tolerance of 90%, indicating pervasive TLS without upstream decryption. NDR requires full payload inspection but receives mostly opaque payloads.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR limited to metadata/flow analysis only; payload signatures, exploit detection, and full-packet anomaly detection are blind for ~94% of traffic, significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption (packet broker decrypt or key forwarding) for relevant VLANs/flows or route decrypted copy to NDR, to bring inspectable payload below 90% threshold while respecting privacy.
